correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the common Gaussian noise makes the one-bit improvement indicators iid across channel columns. Uniform chi-square concentration reduces the conditional event probability to Q(sqrt(alpha*rho))(1+o(1)) at the 1/N scale, and Mills' ratio plus binomial Poisson approximation yields the exact mean e^{-c/2}/(2 sqrt(pi)); the Gumbel and minimax corollaries then follow.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 MIMO paper predicts the NQ(sqrt(rho)) transition and proves only a diverging-slack one-bit converse, while the prior Hu-Lu Poisson law concerns box relaxation at a different threshold. Targeted literature and SCOPE searches found no equivalent one-bit Poisson/Gumbel theorem. Folklore and near-simultaneous risk remain material, so novelty is restricted to the exact critical-window law, Gumbel local-stability threshold, and rectangular extension.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies the exact second-order local-instability window and limiting law at the ML first-order boundary, gives a quantitative constant-window minimax obstruction, and clarifies precisely which unresolved part of the full ML threshold can only come from multi-bit competitors.
